Subject: POC kickoff follow-up: success criteria & timeline

Thanks again for the kickoff today — great convo. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same baseline: 

Summary of agreed success criteria (v1):
- Accuracy: 95% pass rate on the invoice extraction test set (50k tokens)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation <= 400ms for single-item inference (seq len 512)
- Throughput: sustain 200 rps for batch inference for nightly processing window
- Stability: no more than 2 incidents impacting SLA over a 30-day window during the POC

Owners & timeline: 
- Data delivery (Finexa): Mara, deliver sample dataset + schema by EOD 2026-04-05
- Integration & smoke test: Dev (Redwood) + Jake (Finexa) — smoke test by 2026-04-08
- Evaluation run & report: Marissa / Alex — initial results by 2026-04-12

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf (detailed metrics & validation plan)

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) Mara to share dataset link + any ingestion scripts (due 4/5)
2) Dev to confirm access to Finexa staging env and share integration checklist (by 4/4)
3) Schedule 30m sync for 4/6 to validate test harness & acceptance criteria (I will send invite)

If anything above looks off, flag it and I will update the doc. Otherwise, can you confirm dataset delivery date?

Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up: success criteria & timeline

Thanks Marissa — quick note from the engineering side. We want to add an additional evaluation use case to the POC: inference caching / long-context recall across invoice batches. Important for our reconciliation flow.

Proposed addition:
- Use case: Cross-batch recall of invoice references (30-day window) — ability to return previous invoice metadata when given partial reference
- Metric: recall@10 on the cross-batch lookup dataset >= 88%
- Impact: this will require storing/validating KV cache behavior and an extra evaluation harness

This will likely impact the timeline by ~1 week for integration and validation. Also need an internal tech contact for cache config and storage (I can provide infra details).

Can we discuss on the 4/6 sync and see if we can re-baseline?

Jake Turner
Lead ML Engineer, Finexa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff follow-up: success criteria & timeline

Quick technical ack after our sync this morning. Feasible to include cross-batch cache as scoped but calling out granular details so expectations are clear: 
- Approach: use Redwood's KV caching layer with ephemeral storage in the POC (S3-backed with TTL 30 days). We can wire it to your staging env and expose an API for lookups.
- Limitations: TTL-based recall only; not a full persistent DB. If you need transactional guarantees, that would be outside POC scope and requires separate infra.
- Effort estimate: ~3 engineer-days to integrate + 1 engineer-day to add evaluation harness and metrics reporting. Please assume extra compute for nightly evaluation runs (we'll provide cost estimate).

Updated acceptance notes I recommend adding to the POC doc (suggested wording):
- Cache success: recall@10 >= 88% on the cross-batch dataset AND successful retrievals for >90% of keys within 200ms 95th pctl (when served from cache)
- Any retrieval latency above 400ms during eval will be considered a failure for cache-specific tests
I've attached an updated workbook with timeline/owners and checkboxes.

Attachments: Updated_POC_Plan.xlsx

I can take the lead on the integration tasks once Mara confirms access to staging.

Dev Patel
Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
